name: M5 Max (128GB): Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: MLX-LM Metal backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, 4-bit quantization, 128GB unified memory
notes: M5 Max with 128GB unified memory at 614 GB/s. A 70B model at 4-bit requires ~35GB of weights, fitting comfortably. The 614 GB/s bandwidth yields ~22 tokens/sec for decode. The M5 Max is the highest-performance Apple Silicon laptop chip for local inference.
